name: tanpo-retention
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. LoRA (Unsloth, r=16, alpha=16) merged into LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, specialised for customer success, churn save, renewals, expansion, escalation and winback workflows. Identical tensor set to the base; the merged weights are what this repo hosts, with the adapter and GGUF quants published separately. Seventh Tanpo sibling in the catalog, and the weakest of the seven on margin: +1.8 overall on a ~20-task DarkLab automated rubric, with the card openly reporting it TRAILS the base on cs_playbooks (-22.2 pp) and health_scores (-5.5 pp). The internal categories that drove the win (identity_guardrails +34.3, escalation/renewals/winback at 100%) are the ones an automated rubric rewards for structure, so read this as 'the specialist did not break the base and fixed guardrails', not 'better model'. Not Apache-2.0: LFM Open License v1.0 with a ~$10M revenue threshold. Repo created 2026-10-19. Confidence 0.45.

benchmarks.name: DarkLab retention rubric, overall
benchmarks.config: Card '| Model | Rubric overall |': 'Base LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct' 94.2% vs 'tanpo-retention' 96.0%, delta +1.8pp. DarkLab automated domain eval, same prompts and generation config for base vs fine-tune; card labels it directional, not an industry benchmark, small sample. Card discloses losses on cs_playbooks (-22.2pp) and health_scores (-5.5pp).
